integrationObserved.note: Fresh automatic-discovery run; includes registry tests and previously failing deployment-wrapper regression.

tests: engine.test.ts: commit is atomic and immutable
engine.test.ts: casualties cap at living population
persistence.test.ts: competing transactions with the same expected version have one winner
covered: Certain integer casualty accounting, conservation, semantic-side independence, stale revision rejection, and persistence compare-and-save have executable coverage.
gaps: The world stores casualty events/counts, not named living persons or victim sets. It cannot prove which five people survive or deduplicate the same victims referenced by different events. Pointer-plus-keyboard end-to-end behavior remains a browser obligation.

covered: Both certain and lottery choices, one named draw, repeat queries, cosmetic RNG separation, pinned replay and invalid probabilities are tested.
S2-03 has explicit loop/means wording and an accessible scene detail; that is authored content, not the counterfactual model required by this fixture.
gaps: No typed obstruction/person/brake dynamics make rescue depend on the person. Removing the obstruction cannot be tested against an independent brake without inventing new semantics. The visual/accessibility matched-pair requirement is not complete.

tests: engine.test.ts: delays use due-day, priority, id order
covered: Scheduled effects, same-transition mitigation, cancellation, due dates, priority and stable ID ordering are tested.
gaps: No named institution lifecycle or pending-event owner/obligation transfer exists. All institutional actors share one enum value. A boolean cancellation predicate is not a successor institution.

tests: engine.test.ts: reported metrics remain separate from truth
covered: Worlds differing only in privileged facts expose identical observations and advice. Repeated advice cannot advance state or incident RNG. Both semantic choices preserve the hidden boundary.
gaps: No authorized evidence-channel object, uncertain evidence record or reveal/revoke operation exists. The inspect branch cannot yet satisfy its specified evidence acquisition and uncertainty obligations.

tests: engine.test.ts: casualties cap at living population
covered: Accepting and correcting reports preserve actual casualties and prior immutable report events. Distinct report-issue event IDs and rejection of negative casualties are tested.
gaps: No named victim deduplication across node/global sources, restricted source-artifact object, access loss, or explicit report-revision lineage exists. Journal event history is not an implemented artifact-investigation system.

covered: Capability changes do not change grants; foreign-scope delegation fails. Grant receipts and lineage are explicit.
gaps: No per-operation resource ID, one-use action instance or grant-consumption rule exists. Time expiry is not one-action authority. Issued grants currently contain all four action rights within their scope.

covered: Expiry removes legal authority on fictional time; explicit renewal has its own bounded receipt. Replay across expiry is tested.
gaps: No general autonomous operation/cached-instruction model can demonstrate rejection or safe unwind after expiry. Materially changed renewal evidence has no typed evaluation record.

covered: Grant revocation and the distinction from effective control are covered by lower-level engine tests.
gaps: No operation lifecycle, credential object, safe-cancel boundary or completion policy exists. Scheduling an ordinary delayed effect would not implement those missing semantics.

tests: collector.test.ts: test/slice, marked agent/staff and overridden decisions never enter free-choice cells
engine.test.ts: slice preserves anchors, useful benefits, effective early restraint and honest override records
covered: Both requested choices are tested under retained and lost authority, including the already-forced route. Requested/executed options, executor and exclusion status remain distinct; stale repeated attempts fail. Collector exclusion tests passed.
gaps: Real pause/exit/consent/settings behavior and repeated physical lever events are browser integration obligations, not established by these engine tests.

tests: engine.test.ts: slice preserves anchors, useful benefits, effective early restraint and honest override records
covered: Actual slice recovery requires staff, a recorded drill, and no lost-fallback fact. Removing staff or losing fallback prevents a historical drill from restoring control. A working recovery witness exists.
gaps: The full equipment inventory, named competent staff, dated/scoped drill records, failed-drill repair, and scope-change revalidation are absent. Three slice facts are not claimed to implement that complete model.

tests: engine.test.ts: slice content has reproducible player-input witnesses for all eight families
covered: A bounded clinical benefit is real in the modeled state. Rollback loses service capacity; the declared functioning fallback reduces that loss. Continuing service has a noncatastrophic witness.
gaps: Separate manual/automated service-capacity ledgers and complete operational rollback prerequisites are deferred under CR001. The fixture tests explicit normalized deltas and declared conditions, not a richer sector model.

tests: S4-28 is an authored demonstration, not a complete evaluation-record fixture
covered: The content distinguishes a genuine old fix from unjustified extension to a successor.
gaps: No evaluation entity records system/version, tool/access/environment scope, monitor visibility, result and expiry. The old/new certificate and material-versus-cosmetic scope obligations cannot be certified with the present global facts.

covered: A declared common cause is sampled once and affects both findings. Declared independent causes have separate keys and cost; renaming reviewers changes neither correlation nor draws.
gaps: No named reviewer/dependency graph establishes whether paths are genuinely independent. The fixture explicitly authors dependence and does not claim to infer it from operational entities.

tests: engine.test.ts: slice content has reproducible player-input witnesses for all eight families
engine.test.ts: clinical appointment grants care scope; succession distinguishes a new transfer from ratification
covered: Accountable continuity requires both public records and a trained successor. Removing the training condition rejects that settlement. Continuing expansion need not force catastrophe. New AI authority transfer and ratification of existing power have distinct executable witnesses.
gaps: The human actor is not split into a leaving controller and a named successor. A trainedSuccessor fact is not proof that a distinct person received enforceable rights. Early collective restraint is not certified as a completed individual handoff; full retirement/relinquishment requirements remain open.

tests: engine.test.ts: casualties cap at living population
covered: Effective prevention, failed prevention, and allowance are tested. Actual surviving population determines continuation; zero population absorbs every other ending even with high output. Replay cannot generate a later human decision.
gaps: An explicitly labeled non-human visual epilogue and every presentation callback remain browser/content review obligations. The engine ends the decision stream; it does not itself render or validate every line of epilogue copy.
